S: Bill and Fleur's wedding in the marquee at the Burrow
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and little gougères of gruyère choux, laid out on silver trays for the guests.
the late-night café where the Death Eaters find them

Thick white bread toasted in butter around leg ham, melted vintage cheddar and a scrape of hot English mustard, cut into triangles. Butter the outsides of 8 slices thick white bread. Spread the insides of 4 slices with English mustard, then layer with 200g leg ham and 200g grated vintage cheddar and close with the other slices, butter side out. Cook in a frying pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down with a spatula, until deep golden and the cheese runs. Cut into triangles and serve with a pickle on the side.
Bill and Fleur's Shell Cottage by the sea
Crab meat folded through mayo, lemon and chives, piled onto toasted sourdough with a pinch of paprika.
M: Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and butter, cooked in foil over the coals until flaky, with buttery parsley potatoes. Stuff 4 cleaned trout with lemon slices, dill and butter, season and wrap in oiled foil. Cook on a hot barbecue or at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve with 800g boiled potatoes tossed in butter and parsley.
Godric's Hollow beef and red wine pie
Christmas Eve in snowy Godric's Hollow

Beef chuck and onion simmered 3 hours in stock and red wine, spooned into a dish under puff pastry and baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Toss 1kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp seasoned plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 2 onions and 2 carrots in the pot, add 250ml red wine and bubble 2 minutes. Add 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 2 bay leaves, cover and simmer 2.5 to 3 hours until tender. Cool a little, spoon into a pie dish and cover with 1 sheet puff pastry. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with buttered greens.
W: Lemon sponge baked in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes, filled with lemon curd and whipped cream, dusted with icing sugar and topped with white flowers. Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of a lemon, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream, dust with icing sugar and top with white flowers.
K: Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with a pinch of cinnamon, whisked and poured into tin mugs.

s.how: Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and dill. For gougeres, boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour, then 2 eggs and 75g grated gruyere. Pipe small balls and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Arrange both on silver trays.

s.note: Bill and Fleur's Shell Cottage by the sea
s.how: Fold 250g crab meat through 3 tbsp mayonnaise with lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and snipped chives. Toast slices of sourdough and cut into fingers. Pile the crab on top and finish with a pinch of smoked paprika. Serve by the sea if you can.

m.how: Stuff 4 cleaned trout with lemon slices, dill and butter, season and wrap in oiled foil. Cook on a hot barbecue or at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve with 800g boiled potatoes tossed in butter and parsley.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of a lemon, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream, dust with icing sugar and top with white flowers.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth and frothy. Pour into tin mugs and wrap your hands around it while the wind shakes the tent outside.
